import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Set up the figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Digital Camera Market Analysis: Specifications Overview', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Plot 1: Price vs Megapixels by Sensor Type
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
sensor_colors = {'Full Frame': '#e74c3c', 'APS-C': '#3498db', 'Micro 4/3': '#2ecc71'}
for sensor in df['sensor_type'].unique():
    subset = df[df['sensor_type'] == sensor]
    ax1.scatter(subset['megapixels'], subset['price_usd'], 
                alpha=0.6, label=sensor, 
                c=sensor_colors.get(sensor, '#95a5a6'), 
                edgecolors='white', linewidth=0.5)
ax1.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Price vs Megapixels by Sensor Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='Sensor Type', loc='upper left')
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Plot 2: Camera Count by Brand and Body Type
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
brand_body = pd.crosstab(df['brand'], df['body_type'])
brand_body.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax2, colormap='Set2', edgecolor='white', width=0.8)
ax2.set_xlabel('Brand', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Cameras', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Camera Distribution by Brand and Body Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.legend(title='Body Type', loc='upper right')
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# Plot 3: Average Price by Brand and 4K Video Capability
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
avg_price = df.groupby(['brand', 'has_video_4k'])['price_usd'].mean().unstack()
avg_price.columns = ['No 4K', 'Has 4K']
avg_price.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax3, color=['#f39c12', '#9b59b6'], edgecolor='white', width=0.8)
ax3.set_xlabel('Brand', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Average Price (USD)', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Average Price by Brand and 4K Video Capability', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.legend(title='4K Video', loc='upper right')
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# Plot 4: Weight vs Max ISO with Body Type distinction
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
body_markers = {'DSLR': 'o', 'Mirrorless': 's', 'Compact': '^'}
for body in df['body_type'].unique():
    subset = df[df['body_type'] == body]
    ax4.scatter(subset['weight_grams'], subset['max_iso'], 
                alpha=0.6, label=body, 
                marker=body_markers.get(body, 'o'),
                s=50, edgecolors='white', linewidth=0.5)
ax4.set_xlabel('Weight (grams)', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Max ISO', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Weight vs Max ISO by Body Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.legend(title='Body Type', loc='upper right')
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax4.set_yscale('log')

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
